title: Chapter 316: The Identity Of The Zhao County Magistrate
content:
Chapter 316: The Identity Of The Zhao County Magistrate

Wang Shuo sneered and ignored these people.

He was also a little curious at this moment, why was this Zhao Jun Shou so polite to him.

Under the leadership of this commander, Wang Shuo walked towards the Jun Shou Mansion.

The sky above Shanhai City was covered with dark clouds, and the entire city was shrouded in a transparent light curtain.

Wang Shuo had seen this kind of light curtain above Black Dragon City. It looked similar to the water-proof sky curtain, but the water-proof sky curtain could only prevent water, not attack.

Shanhai City was bustling with people, the wide main street was paved with bluestone, and the buildings on both sides were mainly three-story buildings, with red lacquer columns and flying eaves.

Any building was more magnificent than the lord's mansion in Wana Town.

Wang Shuo walked and looked along the way, and was amazed.

After walking for a while, Wang Shuo was taken to a pavilion in the back garden of the Jun Shou Mansion.

The scenery was pleasant with birds singing and flowers blooming here.

Wang Shuo couldn't help but worry, could this Zhao Jun Shou be a woman?

Not long after, a man came over from a distance.

Wang Shuo looked closely and found that the man seemed familiar.

He had a bun on his head and wore court clothes. He was elegant and majestic.

Wang Shuo widened his eyes in disbelief.

"Old Zhao?"

"How dare you! You must not be rude to the governor."

A guard behind Zhao Junshou immediately scolded.

"Back off." Zhao Bangde immediately sent the guard away.

Zhao Junshou was Zhao Bangde, the quartermaster in the ancient battlefield.

Wang Shuo even gave him a five-star praise!

"Didn't expect it! Ah, hahaha..." Zhao Bangde laughed heartily.

Wang Shuo's face was also happy, no wonder.

In this way, everything that happened recently made sense.

"I didn't expect that the little lord who was chased by the ghost at the beginning is now a hegemon."

"I didn't expect that a small quartermaster, who was still a system tool man, is now a giant."

"Hahahaha..."

The two smiled at each other.

Recalling the bits and pieces of the past, the two of them were full of emotion.

"By the way, how did you become the governor of Hedong County?"

"When I was released from prison, Lord Zak gave me two choices, one was to be the leader of a sect in the outer domain, and the other choice was to be the governor of Hedong County in Dahuai Domain."

"I thought about it, the territory outside the domain has basically been divided up, and there is still a lot of room for development in Dahuai Domain, and there is an acquaintance like you here, so I chose this place."

"Then Nanshanji is isolated and helpless, is it also your fault?"

"You have the strength to challenge a small town, of course I have to give you a fair chance."

Zhao Bangde nodded, and then slowly said: "If you can't beat it yourself, I won't help you. You know, people of my generation have been overcoming difficulties along the way, and will encounter countless dangers. Not every time there will be someone to help. Everything depends on yourself."

Wang Shuo nodded in agreement.

"At present, do you need any help?"

Wang Shuo thought about it and shook his head.

"Well, I will treat everyone equally in the next battle. You must prepare for the worst. This battle will be very tragic."

Wang Shuo said solemnly: "Can you tell me how powerful the enemy is?"

Zhao Bangde said seriously: "There are 1.5 million ordinary undead, 600,000 elite undead, 10 junior generals, and 1 intermediate general, that is, the supreme commander of the Burning Legion, Arif Ubol."

"This is the most conservative estimate. In addition, there are countless undead beasts."

Even though Wang Shuo had expected it, his heart was still like a turmoil.

After a while, he asked again: "Then...what about us?"

Wang Shuo looked at Zhao Bangde and wanted to know how strong he was now.
